entities.summary: Ushna Suhail is a female tennis player from Pakistan. With a world ranking of #943 in 2016, Suhail became and still remains the highest ranked female tennis player in Pakistan's history. Ushna Suhail was a athletes & competitors from Lahore (b. 1993-06-26, Lahore). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
